statements.status_notes: Upstream GHSA-88vh-gx85-p36m (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-88vh-gx85-p36m) covers the plaintext username:password auth cookie set after POST /login. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected, the newest fixed release it names is 4.3.2, and does not list the 4.4 series. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, deps/rabbitmq_management/src/rabbit_mgmt_wm_login.erl no longer sets the auth cookie on a successful login (it has no set_resp_cookie call) and returns the credential token in the response body instead. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its only published build, on amd64 and arm64, is 4.4.1-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.1 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.1, rabbitmq_management-4.4.1, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.1 and amqp10_common-4.4.1). That build carries the fix, so the range is fixed at 4.4.1-0.

Upstream GHSA-88vh-gx85-p36m (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-88vh-gx85-p36m) covers the plaintext username:password auth cookie set after POST /login. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected, the newest fixed release it names is 4.3.2, and does not list the 4.4 series. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, deps/rabbitmq_management/src/rabbit_mgmt_wm_login.erl no longer sets the auth cookie on a successful login (it has no set_resp_cookie call) and returns the credential token in the response body instead. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its published builds, on amd64 and arm64, are 4.4.0-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.0 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.0, rabbitmq_management-4.4.0, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.0 and amqp10_common-4.4.0), and 4.4.1-0, 4.4.1-1 and 4.4.1-2, which ship RabbitMQ 4.4.1. Every published build carries the fix, so the range starts fixed at the lowest one, 4.4.0-0.
